tpl.mediator.b1: A Gym Leader and your rival are arguing in the town square over who gets the arena tomorrow. Neither will back down.
tpl.mediator.b2: Both turn to you at once. "You tell them," they say together, and glare at each other.
tpl.champion_notices.b1: A woman in a plain coat watches your battle from the fence. When it ends she walks over. It is the Champion.
tpl.champion_notices.b2: "Your {starter} does a little hop before it attacks. Who taught it that?" She smiles. "Spar with me. Just one exchange."
tpl.quiet_hand.b1: The lights in the station fail all at once. In the dark a hand closes on your sleeve and pulls you behind a pillar.
tpl.quiet_hand.b2: "Not here," a voice whispers, one you have heard in a uniform before. "I can help you, if you help me."
tpl.messages.b1: Your rival's device buzzes for the third time. They glance at it and flip it face down, too fast.
tpl.messages.b2: "It's nothing," they say, before you asked anything.
tpl.background_legend.b1: For the third time today you see it: a huge silhouette against the clouds, gone when you blink.
tpl.background_legend.b2: {starter} saw it first. It is still staring at the empty sky, very still, like it is listening.
tpl.background_legend.c.wait: Wait for it to come back.
tpl.concerned_trainer.b1: A trainer steps into your path. "Your {starter} looks worn out. Do you ever let it rest?"
tpl.concerned_trainer.b2: "I'll battle you for it. No items. If you lose, you rest here tonight. Deal?"
tpl.concerned_trainer.c.rest: Admit they might be right, and rest.
tpl.sibling.b1: A letter is waiting at the Pokémon Center. The handwriting is shaky. A trainer you once helped needs you: their brother has gone missing near the old mine.
tpl.sibling.b2: Two ways in: the quiet service tunnel, or straight through the front gate.
tpl.closed_doors.b1: The Gym door has a hand-written sign: CLOSED. Inside, the Leader sits alone on the arena floor.
tpl.closed_doors.b2: "I lost four in a row," they say. "Maybe the Gym doesn't need me."
tpl.closed_doors.c.help: Help them with the chores, and talk.
tpl.closed_doors.c.challenge: Challenge them to snap out of it.
tpl.stranger_challenger.b1: A masked trainer is waiting at the route gate. "Battle me. One of my Pokémon will be holding back." They do not explain.
tpl.stranger_challenger.b2: You win, barely. The stranger nods, as if a box had been ticked, and walks off without a word.
tpl.follower.b1: For three stops now, the same small wild Pokémon has been trailing your party. It hides when you turn around.
tpl.follower.b2: Tonight it sits at the edge of your campfire light, watching your food.
tpl.follower.c.feed: Leave some food out for it.
tpl.two_rivals.b1: At the festival, two of your rivals spot you at the same time and both hurry over.
tpl.two_rivals.b2: "Tell them my team is better." "Tell them mine is." The crowd is watching.
tpl.two_rivals.c.duo: Suggest the three of you team up for the duo show.
tpl.two_rivals.c.pick: Praise the one who trained harder.
tpl.thief_mon.b1: Something tugs your bag, and a small blur bolts into the market with one of your items in its mouth.
tpl.thief_mon.b2: The chase runs through fruit stalls and under carts, until the thief is cornered behind a bakery, holding your item like a treasure.
tpl.thief_mon.c.bargain: Trade it a snack for the item.
tpl.false_name.b1: The friendly traveller from two towns ago said they were from the coast. Today they told someone else they grew up in the hills.
tpl.false_name.b2: They catch you listening. Their smile stays, but their eyes go flat.
tpl.champion_lesson.b1: The Champion finds you again. "Three turns. You don't attack, you only read me. Ready?"
tpl.champion_lesson.b2: By the third turn you can see her next move before she calls it. "There," she says. "That's Standing Ground."
tpl.lost_ace.b1: Your rival lost a big match today, the kind everyone heard about. Now nobody can find them.
tpl.lost_ace.b2: You find them on the roof of the Pokémon Center, ace's Poké Ball in their hands, saying nothing.
tpl.copycat.b1: A trainer at the gym is using your exact strategy, move for move. They even copy how you stand.
tpl.copycat.b2: "I watched you," they admit, red-faced. "It works. I wanted it to work for me."
tpl.copycat.c.counter: Show them how to beat it.
tpl.photograph.b1: Inside a second-hand book you find an old photograph: young researchers in front of an institute, squinting in the sun.
tpl.photograph.b2: One face is Professor Vance. The others you half recognise from wanted posters and League banners.
tpl.private_life.b1: At the edge of a gala, a Gym Leader and a stranger in a dark coat exchange a folded note and a look that lasts too long.
tpl.private_life.b2: The stranger wears a pin you have seen on the other side of a battle.
tpl.returned_rescue.b1: In the middle of the worst storm of the trip, a familiar shape bursts out of the rain: the little Pokémon you fed weeks ago.
tpl.returned_rescue.b2: It has grown. It plants itself beside {starter} and faces the storm with you.
tpl.rejected.b1: The trainer you turned down at the start of the road is waiting at the route gate, arms crossed.
tpl.rejected.b2: "You didn't think I was good enough. I've been training since. Let's see now."
tpl.divided_loyalty.b1: Mid-battle, your rival's ace freezes. It is looking at {starter}, not at the fight.
tpl.divided_loyalty.b2: Your rival notices too. For a second they look lost.
tpl.radio.b1: Your radio crackles past midnight. Static, then a voice reading numbers in a careful order.
tpl.radio.b2: The broadcast repeats. If you could find where it comes from, you might learn what is planned.
tpl.researcher_notice.b1: A researcher with a clipboard stops you. "Your {starter}'s readings are... unusual. May I study it for an hour?"
tpl.recruited_leader.b1: A Gym is empty. Every lamp is on, and on the Leader's desk is a note: "Gone to where strength is honoured. Do not follow."
tpl.recruited_leader.b2: The note is pinned with a laurel-shaped club pin.
tpl.final_battle.b1: An envelope with an old League seal: a former Champion, long retired, asks for one last battle.
tpl.final_battle.b2: "Not for the crown. For the memory of it."
tpl.proof.b1: A kid at the café refuses to believe you beat that Gym Leader. "Prove it!"
tpl.proof.c.scar: Show the scorch mark on your bag.
tpl.ancient_recognition.b1: A wild Pokémon in an old regional form steps out of the trees and bows to you, low and slow.
tpl.ancient_recognition.b2: You remember the old greeting. Your hands make it before you think.
tpl.two_suitors.b1: Two trainers are shouting over a wild Pokémon that clearly does not belong to either of them.
tpl.two_suitors.b2: "You decide!" they both say to you. The Pokémon looks at you too.
tpl.signature_trade.b1: A friend from earlier in the journey finds you. "You helped me when nobody would. I want you to have something."
tpl.signature_trade.b2: They hold out a Poké Ball: their own signature Pokémon. "Look after it. If I ever ask, you bring it back."
tpl.team_up.b1: The way ahead is blocked by something too big for one trainer. Your rival walks up beside you without a word.
tpl.team_up.b2: "Same plan as always?" they ask. You never had a plan. You nod anyway.
eevee.stay: {pokemon} watches the light fade, then bumps your hand. It seems content to be exactly what it is.
eevee.vaporeon.b1: The rain at {place} had not stopped for an hour. {pokemon} sat at the edge of the water, ears flat, then waded in until only its head showed. It looked back at {player} and did not shiver.
eevee.vaporeon.b2: Something in the way {pokemon} floated was calm, the kind of calm that is not the same as being brave. A soft blue light moved under its fur, like the lake had decided to keep a little of it.
eevee.jolteon.b1: The storm over {place} turned the sky white twice before the thunder came. Everyone else ducked. {pokemon} stood up, fur lifting, every hair bright with static, and laughed in the quick, breathless way it does before a race.
eevee.jolteon.b2: {player} felt the air prickle. The sparks did not fade. They ran down its legs and into the grass in neat blue lines. It looked ready to run for a week.
eevee.flareon.b1: The fire at {place} was small, only a camp stove and a handful of embers, but {pokemon} would not leave it. It crept closer than was sensible and pressed its nose against the warm iron.
eevee.flareon.b2: The fur around its neck began to glow orange, not burning, only warming from inside, like a coal waiting to be breathed on. It sneezed and a tiny spark jumped. Then it grinned, proud and a little singed.
eevee.espeon.b1: Morning at {place}, and {pokemon} was awake before you. It sat very still, looking at the lightening sky as if it had heard its name.
eevee.espeon.b2: When you reached for the water flask, {pokemon} was already pushing it your way. A violet light gathered between its eyes and settled into a small gem. It seemed to know your next thought and was too polite to say it.
eevee.umbreon.b1: Night at {place}. The camp was dark, and for the first time {pokemon} was not afraid of it. It walked out past the firelight and stood where the shadows were deepest, watching.
eevee.umbreon.b2: A faint ring of gold appeared on its ears, then its forehead, glowing softly like moon-lit letters. It came back and pressed against your leg, warm and sure. The dark had been a friend all along.
eevee.leafeon.b1: The mossy rock at {place} was the first thing that day {pokemon} would not walk past. It lay down on it and stayed. Light came through the leaves in coins.
eevee.leafeon.b2: Small green shoots curled out of its tail, and the air smelled of rain and cut grass. It was not a dramatic change, more like a plant turning toward light it had always had.
eevee.glaceon.b1: The frozen rock at {place} cracked in the cold, and {pokemon} pressed its paw against the ice and kept it there. Breath fogged in front of both of you.
eevee.glaceon.b2: Frost climbed its fur in small, careful patterns, like writing. It stepped lightly on the snow and left a clean print. It looked as if it had learned to enjoy the cold on purpose.
eevee.sylveon.b1: Nothing dangerous happened at {place}. That was the point. You shared your food, sat through a long afternoon, and when {player} was low, {pokemon} stayed pressed against your side.
eevee.sylveon.b2: Pink and white ribbons grew from its ears and drifted in the air as if held by a hand you could not see. It had been learning, one kindness at a time, how to carry what you felt.
camp.rivalry.1: {a} and {b} race to the stream and back, twice, then a third time because neither will admit the second was a tie.
camp.rivalry.2: {a} knocks over a training log. {b} knocks over a bigger one, and looks at {a} as if to say: your move.
camp.mentor.1: {a} shows {b} how to dodge a falling pinecone. {b} gets hit four times, then dodges the fifth, and {a} looks very proud.
camp.mentor.2: {b} copies {a}'s battle stance all evening, a little wobbly. {a} pretends not to notice, then fixes its footing.
camp.protective.1: A noise in the dark. {a} is between it and {b} before anyone else is awake.
camp.protective.2: {b} trips on a root. {a} is already there, nudging it back up, glaring at the root.
camp.dislike.1: {a} and {b} sit on opposite sides of the fire, backs turned. The berries end up split exactly in half.
camp.dislike.2: {a} takes {b}'s favourite sleeping spot. {b} stares at it for a long time.
camp.inseparable.1: {a} and {b} fall asleep in a heap, and neither moves when you add a blanket.
camp.inseparable.2: {a} will not eat until {b} has eaten. {b} will not eat until {a} has. You end up feeding them at the same time.
camp.jealousy.1: {b} watches you praise {a} and turns its back. It is very obviously not sulking.
camp.jealousy.2: {b} brings you a stick, then another, then a whole branch, while {a} gets its fur brushed.
camp.comfort.1: {b} startles at every owl hoot. {a} lies down beside it, slow and heavy, until it stops shaking.
camp.comfort.2: Thunder rumbles far off. {a} hums. {b} closes its eyes.
camp.daredevil.1: {a} and {b} dare each other to the edge of the cliff and back. You do not watch.
camp.daredevil.2: {a} and {b} come back from the river soaked, delighted, and carrying a fish neither of them can explain.
camp.odd_couple.1: {a} tries to organise the camp. {b} unorganises it, piece by piece, very cheerfully.
camp.odd_couple.2: {a} naps. {b} balances berries on {a}'s head until the stack falls over and everyone laughs.
camp.caretaker.1: {a} has not left {b}'s side since the last battle. It keeps checking the bandage.
camp.caretaker.2: {a} brings {b} the softest leaves for its bed and arranges them twice.
camp.idol.1: {b} copies the way {a} yawns. Then the way it stretches. Then the way it glares at a Starly.
camp.idol.2: {b} follows {a} around camp all evening, three steps behind, matching its walk.
camp.old_friends.1: {a} and {b} sit together looking at the stars, the way family does, without needing anything to happen.
camp.old_friends.2: {a} and {b} share a memory nobody else in the party has. You can tell from how they both look at the same tree.
